caption: The Draft Review workspace opens the financial spreading agent's draft for Ridgeline Composites beside the evidence it cites: every figure on the standard spread template carries the document, page and document location it was read from, the four template lines the single filed statement cannot support read 'not supported by the record' rather than an estimate, and the whole spread sits PENDING until a named human accepts it.
